description: Analyst price-target consensus for a company — high, low, mean, and median 12-month price targets, and when they were last updated. Requires your own PAID Finnhub API key with price-target access, passed as _apiKey — Pipeworx's shared key is on a lower plan and cannot reach this endpoint. For free analyst buy/hold/sell trends without a key requirement beyond the shared one, use get_recommendation_trends instead. Example: get_price_target({ symbol: "AAPL", _apiKey: "your_finnhub_key" })

_apiKey.description: Your own Finnhub API key on a PAID plan that includes price-target data (finnhub.io/pricing). The shared Pipeworx key is on a lower plan and cannot reach this endpoint, unlike the other tools in this pack. Free analyst buy/hold/sell trends are available without this via get_recommendation_trends.

name: get_price_target

last_updated.description: When the price-target consensus was last updated
